hero.titleA: A calmer way to care for the people
hero.lead: Hearth connects what is already in your parent's home, like a Ring doorbell, Alexa+ and simple home sensors, to give you daily peace of mind. No video, no intrusion, and your parent always in control.
hero.imageAlt: An older woman smiling in her living room while her family waves from a video call on the TV

how.title: A quiet signal, not a camera.

steps.title: Connect what is already there
steps.body: Door, motion and appliance sensors through Home Assistant, plus a check-in button on the parent's Hearth screen. Nothing new to wear.

steps.title: Hearth learns the routine
steps.body: After seven days it knows a usual morning. Until then it says "not enough data" instead of guessing.

steps.title: The family gets a calm daily status
steps.body: Normal, worth a look, or no signal, always with how Hearth knows and one suggested next step.

items.title: Why Cards
items.body: When a morning is quieter than usual you get what was observed, the usual pattern, the evidence and one proportionate step, like a call.

items.title: Piggyback Planner
items.body: Visiting Saturday? Hearth suggests the errand that fits your trip. Nothing is assigned until you say yes.

items.title: Moments
items.body: Send a short message or video that appears on your parent's Hearth screen, and see when it was seen.

items.title: Ask with Alexa+
items.body: A Hearth MCP connector answers "how is Mom doing?" with exactly what she shares. Live Alexa+ connection is still in testing.

items.title: Choose what the family sees
items.body: Four simple levels, from a status only to more detail for a few days after a hospital stay. It goes back by itself.

items.title: See who looked
items.body: The Trust Ledger lists every time someone viewed your information and every change, in plain words.

items.title: I'm away
items.body: Visiting your sister? One tap and nobody worries about a quiet house.

items.title: Big, calm screen
items.body: Large buttons, readable type, messages from family, and an honest help button.

privacy.title: The parent's choice is enforced on the server.
privacy.lead: The Glimpse Dial is not a hidden panel in an app. Every answer, in the family app or through Alexa+, is built from the fields the parent allows, and every disclosure is recorded.

levels.name: Recovery
levels.body: + chosen extras, for a few days

facts: Family members cannot raise the level. Only the parent, or a delegate the parent names.
No facial recognition, no live video, no guessing who someone is.
Every view and every change is written to the Trust Ledger.
Hearth is not a medical device or an emergency service.

self.name: Self-hosted
self.note: AGPL-3.0, on your own server or a home computer

hosted.name: Hosted family plan
hosted.note: We will host it for you. No date has been set.

cta.title: Start with one normal day.
cta.body: Create your family circle, pair your parent's screen, and let them choose what to share.

footer.disclaimer: Hearth is not a medical device or an emergency service. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

benefits.title: Daily reassurance
benefits.body: A simple daily signal that your loved one is doing well.

benefits.title: Less coordination stress
benefits.body: Visits, errands and tasks organised in one place.

benefits.title: More meaningful connection
benefits.body: Send messages and short videos to your parent's Hearth screen.

benefits.title: Built for privacy
benefits.body: No video, ever. Your parent chooses what to share.
